newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Serfin ADRs begun as sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Serfin ADRs begun as sell.

text.p: Santander Investment said in a statement on Wednesday it started coverage of the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) for Grupo Financiero Serfin as a sell.

Mexico City bank analysts Robert Lacoursiere and Laura Berdeja said they kept a buy recommendation for the bank's Series B shares in Mexico, "for those medium-term investors willing to take higher risk."

"We recommend selling the ADRs given that the current price of $3.13 is above our target price," the analysts wrote. Lacoursiere told Reuters the ADRs and Series B shares are not technically linked because each ADR equals four of the bank's Series L shares.

The brokerage lowered its 1997 earnings per share estimate for Serfin to $0.01 from $0.07 and its 1998 estimate to $0.07 from $0.13, to reflect poorer asset quality and high funding costs, the report said.
Serfin ADR shares were down 1/4 in midday trading to 2 7/8, and Series B shares were unchanged from 2.60 pesos each.
